title: Work order part lookup no longer offers a part once it is inactive
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WOLOOK-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL WOLOOK PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) at {Location-A} is open and has an approved line, {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL WOLOOK line"), that holds no parts.
  • Before {Part-A} was set inactive, typing the start of its number in that line's part lookup offered it.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. On {Line-1} open the line's ⋮ menu and click "Request part".
  3. In the "New Part Request" dialog type the start of {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WOL) in Part Number.
  4. Clear Part Number and type {Description-A}.
  5. Close the dialog with ×.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The "New Part Request" dialog opens.
  • Step 3: No row for {Part-A} is offered: no inventory row with "Inventory Qty" and no "Part Library" row. If nothing else matches, the list reads "No results".
  • Step 4: Again no row for {Part-A} is offered.
  • Step 5: The dialog closes and {Line-1} still holds no parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R1, S9-E10, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 6.1 (While active: GREASETUBE is found) and 6.2 (Once inactive: not offered), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7; SV-10822 acceptance criteria (the PRD wins where they differ). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R1: “Part lookup on a work order line does not return inactive parts.”
  • S9-E10: “If ShopView adds a way to raise a part request from a purchase order, it uses the purchase order's part lookup, which leaves inactive parts out (S9-R5). Today part requests are raised on the work order (S9-R1).”
  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given GREASETUBE is inactive, when the user searches "GREASE" on a work order, estimate, part sale, purchase order or technician charge-out, then it is not offered, neither as an inventory part nor as a Part Library entry.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7, ListingQueryHandler: “Covers WO, estimate, tech charge-out (every device), PO, vendor-bill re-point, part sale”
